blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Philippine Coast Guard rescued 58 passengers from a roll-on/roll-off vessel that tilted to its right side about 10 meters from the port of Real, Quezon before daybreak on Friday. The MV Virgen de Peñafrancia II had just arrived from Polillo Island and was preparing to dock at the port in Barangay Ungos at 12:44 a.m. when it began to topple. The vessel’s 40 passengers and 18 crew members, including two infants, were safely evacuated.
